name: combat
summary: One attack from the roll to the HP lost: one attack roll read against the defender's evasion and block bands.

flags.description: Flags from conditions (prone, blinded, invisible); a situation row with `when` reads them.

weapon_properties.description: The carried weapon's properties, which a maneuver may need.

weapon_effects.description: The weapon's on-hit applied effects: armor_pierce, bane, lingering_damage, banish_summoned (docs/core/combat.md#weapon-effects).

perks.description: The attacker's held perks (feature refs). A rider perk among them whose maneuver fits the attack makes a maneuver attempt after a plain hit (docs/core/actions.md#rider-perks); two riders that fit the same attack are an error.

shield_dr.description: The carried shield's DR; it adds to armor_dr against types with armor_dr_applies.

shields_skill.description: The shields skill the block stance's band reads.

armor.description: The heaviest body armor worn, none when left out (clothes and robes are none). Unarmored Grace's unarmored_evasion_band widens the band only with none.

weapon_skill.description: The held weapon's skill: a parry grant reads it for the parry band, floor(weapon_skill / stances.rules.parry_band_divisor), and block_with_weapon lets the block band read it when it beats shields_skill (docs/core/combat.md#fighting-stances). A parry grant without it is an error.

stance.description: The stance the defender declared on their turn: dodge (doubles the evasion band) or block (adds a block band; needs shield_dr and shields_skill). Any other value is an error.

loadout.description: What the defender holds; with a weapon in each hand, the defender's modifiers on two_weapon_evasion_band widen the evasion band (Crossed Guard).

creature_type.description: The defender's creature type (undead, beast, ...), which a weapon's bane reads.

flags.description: Flags from conditions (prone, blinded, invisible); a situation row with `when` reads them.

modifiers.description: The defender's perks and fighting stance (the stance command's modifiers): adds on evasion, evasion_band, shields, block_band, shield_dr, two_weapon_evasion_band, unarmored_evasion_band, and spell_ward (the tier), and the bulwark, riposte, parry, and block_with_weapon grants.

ability.description: The attacker attribute whose modifier adds to the roll.

summoning.description: Whether the attacker has an active summon (not a minion), for its while_summoning modifiers. Default false; the beside_summon situation implies true (docs/core/modifier.md).

situations.description: Keys in ruleset/data/combat/situations.json the caller names (cover, flanking, into melee).

loadout.description: What the attacker holds: a maneuver's AP is then the loadout's attack AP (attack_sequences/core.json) plus its own. A loadout no attack sequence covers is an error.

maneuver.description: A maneuvers key in ruleset/data/maneuvers/core.json: the attack is performed as that maneuver (docs/core/actions.md#maneuvers).

evasion_rate.description: The evasion band: a margin under it is evaded.

block_rate.description: The block stance's band, under the evasion band: a margin in it is blocked.

parry_rate.description: A parrying stance's band, under the block band: a margin in it is blocked and parried. 0 without a parry grant, against non-physical damage, or for an instant attack.

parried.description: The parry band stopped the hit (outcome blocked).

warded.description: Spell Ward: a spell (a type without the DR tag) whose roll landed in the block band while blocking. It still hits, with ward_percent of its damage resisted.

ward_percent.description: The percent Spell Ward resisted: spell_ward_percent (END x 2 x tier) at most spell_ward_max_percent (50); 0 when not warded.

stagger_ap.description: Bulwark: AP the attacker loses on their next turn.

riders.description: A called shot's riders on a hit.

counter.description: A riposte: the defender may make one attack at no AP cost.

ap.description: With a maneuver: the attack's AP plus the maneuver's, at least 1.

stamina.description: With a maneuver: ap times stamina_per_ap, its cost in real time.

effects.description: With a maneuver or a rider: its applied effects on a hit, empty on a miss or an evade. With a save, they land only when the defender fails it.

events.description: With a maneuver or a rider: its events on a hit (disarm), empty otherwise.

attribute.description: The weapon's attribute (damage.ability) the attempt is made with.

dc.description: The attacker's attribute times maneuver_save_multiplier, plus the maneuver's save_bonus (none for a rider).

target.description: The defender's d100 save target, 100 minus the DC and never below 0; the caller rolls it, and a failed save lands the effects and events.

save.description: A maneuver attempt on a hit (a maneuver with a save_bonus, or a rider), docs/core/actions.md#the-maneuver-attempt; left out otherwise.

rider.description: The maneuver a held rider perk put on this plain attack.

weapon_effects.description: With weapon effects: those that land on a hit (docs/core/combat.md#weapon-effects), empty on a miss, an evade, or a block. Left out without weapon effects.
